ltmorales.Caduceus Feedback: Bonus range keeps you out of reach while feeding Energy, so Stim Drone and Safeguard come online faster.
ltmorales.Trauma Trigger: Your anti-dive layer, the armor procs the moment you get focused so you don't get bursted before healing back.
ltmorales.Physical Therapy: Turns Safeguard into a slow-cleanse on a short cooldown, take it to keep your carry mobile vs slow-heavy comps.
ltmorales.Stim Drone: The reason you draft Morales, turns your best auto-attacker into a monster for the fight.
ltmorales.EMP Grenade: Extra poke that shreds shields, take it vs shield-stacking comps like Zarya or Medivh.
ltmorales.Extended Care: Boosts single-target throughput, your beam target keeps healing while you weave off to safety.
ltmorales.Hyperactivity: Near double Stim uptime plus more kite speed, one boost for every fight, doubling down on your carry-buffing job.

lucio.Accelerando: Your rotation and disengage speed, ramps while wall-riding so you outrun everything and enable global map play.
lucio.Subwoofer: Boops divers farther to peel, and the quest range makes your knockback reach into their backline.
lucio.Boombox: Doubles your aura output on the objective, allies get speed or heal plus armor while you fight.
lucio.Sound Barrier: Your teamfight save button, drop it before their wombo to soak the burst that would wipe your team.
lucio.All Together: More allies on your speed track means more team speed, snowballs your speed-wins-fights identity.
lucio.Rejuvenescência: Extra sustained healing while amped, take it when you need to out-heal poke rather than out-speed it.
lucio.House Party: Scales healing with a stacked team, the pick when fights are 5-man clumps and you're the main healer.

lunara.Sentinel Wisp: Free map vision from your Wisp, the safe default to scout objectives and ganks without risking yourself.
lunara.Blossom Swell: Ramps your poison from range, faster toxin stacking means faster DPS and better zoning of a clump.
lunara.Splintered Spear: Big multi-target hit that spreads Nature's Toxin across their whole team, huge wave clear too.
lunara.Thornwood Vine: Long-range burst that banks charges, the damage ult when you want to out-poke rather than control fights.
lunara.Greater Spell Shield: Your survival pick vs burst mages, eats their key ability so you keep dancing at range.
lunara.Invigorating Spores: Your DPS spike once poison is stacked, take it to melt tanks with sustained auto-attacks.
lunara.Forest's Wrath: Turns your ult into a poison applicator and extends range and vision, ramping late-game poison pressure.

maiev.Pursuit of Vengeance: Keeps Spirit of Vengeance up nonstop, your engage and escape tool comes back faster the more you tether.
maiev.Pin Down: Rewards hitting clumps with your cleave, complete it and your AoE burst and wave clear spike hard.
maiev.Bonds of Corruption: Amps the follow-up on a pinned target, the armor shred sets up your team to delete them.
maiev.Containment Disc: Take a key target out of the fight for 4 seconds, isolate their tank or delay a save during your dive.
maiev.Bladed Armor: Free survivability when you cleave a clump, lets you dive into multiple enemies and live.
maiev.Vengeful Knives: Adds percent-health burst to your cleave, take it to melt tanks alongside the squishies.
maiev.Shadow Orb: Vengeance: Double-engage or double-escape on demand, chain your wall combos or bail from a lost fight.

malfurion.Deep Roots: Bigger, longer root to lock their engage, and the mana quest fuels your spammy healing all game.
malfurion.Rejuvenation: Free self-sustain every time you heal an ally, keeps you topped to play aggressive with Moonfire poke.
malfurion.Wild Growth: Rewards weaving Moonfire poke, each hit stretches your heal-over-times for more efficient sustain.
malfurion.Twilight Dream: Your AoE silence teamfight ult, lock a clump to stop their casts or peel a dive off your carry.
malfurion.Nature's Swiftness: Kiting speed while heals are rolling, stay out of reach as you sustain, take it vs dive.
malfurion.Nature's Balance: Wider Moonfire and longer Regrowth, cranks your poke-and-sustain engine for max efficiency.
malfurion.Serenity: Refreshes and amplifies Tranquility, spam near-constant AoE healing to out-sustain drawn-out fights.

malganis.Winged Guard: Your baseline tankiness vs autos, stack armor by hitting their frontline so you shrug off attacks while draining.
malganis.Echo of Doom: Cranks Necrotic Embrace uptime and AoE, more armor procs and more sustain in a clump.
malganis.Black Claws: Sets up your kill pressure, the armor shred amps your and your team's follow-up burst on a target.
malganis.Carrion Swarm: Invulnerable escape that also deals damage, dodge their combo mid-fight then keep draining.
malganis.Deep Sleep: Longer sleep to take their carry out of the fight, your signature pick to set up a kill from the flank.
malganis.Plague Bats: Adds real burst to your rotation, take it when you need damage over pure tankiness.
malganis.Wrath of Nathreza: Turns your single-target sleep-kill into AoE burst, punishes them for grouping near the target.

malthael.Death's Reach: More gap-close and reset range on Wraith Strike, stick to fleeing targets and chain-reset through a fight.
malthael.Throwing Shade: Your main DPS and Reaper's Mark applicator, cheaper and wider so you keep marks on their whole team.
malthael.Cold Hand: Sticky slow to catch kiters, closes the gap so ranged heroes can't peel you off.
malthael.Tormented Souls: Marks their whole team for massive sustained AoE, your teamfight ult that also heals you through it.
malthael.Soul Siphon: Turns tanks into your health pack, out-sustain their frontline while you shred it.
malthael.Soul Collector: More frequent Soul Rips means more healing and DPS, ramps your bruiser sustain engine.
malthael.Reaper of Souls: Keeps your AoE mark rolling as long as you get kills, snowballs a won teamfight into an ace.

medivh.Portal Mastery: Full control of both portal ends, the standard pick to set up huge engages or instant escapes anywhere.
medivh.Mage Armor: Rewards allies for using your portals, the armor turns a portal into a save vs burst dives.
medivh.Force of Magic: Ramps your damage by shielding well, take it to poke harder with Arcane Rift between saves.
medivh.Poly Bomb: Chain-disable their clumped team, silence a key caster then watch it hop to the rest.
medivh.Enduring Will: Near-permanent shield uptime, block their big hits back-to-back to keep your carry alive.
medivh.Arcane Charge: Turns poke into real damage, rewards consistent Rift hits for chip pressure between fights.
medivh.Guardian of Tirisfal: Instant wave clear from your poke, take it to solo-hold a lane and free your team to roam.

mei.Ice Storm: Buffs your main setup, more Blizzard damage and a beefier stun to lock a clump for your team.
mei.Slushball: Stronger blind for peel and it shuts off forts, take it for both teamfight and siege pressure.
mei.Induce Hibernation: Turns Blizzard into a defensive zone, drop it on your team to gut their burst in a fight.
mei.Avalanche: Your grab-and-displace ult, roll their backline into your team or peel a whole dive off your carry.
mei.Cooling Servos: Refreshes your abilities while invulnerable, freeze mid-fight then come out with everything up.
mei.Fresh Powder: Double blind uptime, lock down two auto-attackers or extend your peel across a longer fight.
mei.Flash Freeze: A free second life every fight, bait their whole combo then walk away, cementing your unkillable peel.

mephisto.Malicious Intent: Your damage ramp, the spell power while shading powers your skull spam and rotations.
mephisto.Hateful Mending: Free sustain and mana off your main poke, spam skulls to stay on the map without recalling.
mephisto.Ghastly Armor: Survivability when you dive in with Shade, the armor covers you while you reposition out.
mephisto.Consume Souls: Map-wide execute, finish low targets anywhere and turn any won skirmish into a teamwipe.
mephisto.Abhorred Skull: Doubles down on skull spam, ramps your poke and adds execute damage on low targets.
mephisto.Static Field: Adds burst when you dive a clump with Nova, punishes them for grouping near you.
mephisto.Consumed by Hatred: Turns your ult into a true global execute that can cast twice, wins fights outright when they're low.

muradin.Third Wind: Your infinite sustain, stay topped between fights so you can body-block and peel without recalling.
muradin.Thunder Burn: Extra wave clear and poke, and it doubles your slow zone to lock down their frontline.
muradin.Heavy Impact: Adds a strong slow to your leap, gap-close and peel divers off your backline.
muradin.Avatar: Your unkillable engage button, dive in as a giant meatshield and soak their whole combo.
muradin.Healing Static: Sustain scaled to their clump, spam Clap in a teamfight to stay full while you peel.
muradin.Stoneform: An on-demand full heal to survive focus, take it vs burst comps that try to blow you up.
muradin.Rewind: Double stun, clap and toss in one fight, your peel and CC output doubles at the key moment.

murky.Egg Hunt: Hides your real egg among decoys and buffs your respawn, keep them guessing and stay unkillable.
murky.Tufferfish: Protects your bomb from being popped and rewards sliming first, your main teamfight and wave damage.
murky.Slippery When Wet: Turns your bubble into an escape and engage tool, dodge in and out of their whole team untouched.
murky.Octo-Grab: A guaranteed 3-second lockdown, pin their carry so your team collapses, your real teamfight contribution.
murky.Rejuvenating Bubble: Full sustain every bubble, makes you even more of a time-wasting nuisance they can't kill.
murky.Toxic Buildup: Auto-applies your slime for constant DPS, ramps your in-your-face auto-attack harassment.
murky.Big Tuna Kahuna: Doubles your HP for real teamfight staying power, trade the fast respawn to become a bruiser.

nazeebo.Widowmakers: Sticky spiders for kiting, and the attack quest ramps your spider DPS all game.
nazeebo.Big Voodoo: More health and mana from stacks, stays tanky and topped so you can stack safely into late game.
nazeebo.Spirit of Arachyr: More spiders means more stacks and DPS, accelerates your ramp toward the 175 quest.
nazeebo.Gargantuan: A beefy AoE bruiser summon, zone objectives and add sustained damage plus a stun with the upgrade.
nazeebo.Superstition: Spell armor plus a spider on your attacker, take it when melee assassins try to blow you up.
nazeebo.Spider Colony: Turns spider uptime into ability spam, floods the fight with zombies and spiders for huge AoE.
nazeebo.Vile Infection: The payoff for stacking all game, Voodoo Ritual becomes a hero-melting DoT, your late-game monster spike.

nova.Longshot: More range to open safely, land your slow-and-snipe from max distance before they can react.
nova.Covert Mission: Free merc camps from your soak, snowball map pressure while you wait for a pick.
nova.Perfect Shot: Rewards landing snipes, near-spammable poke that chunks their squishies from safety.
nova.Triple Tap: Your long-range one-shot combo, delete a squishy from across the fight without leaving stealth.
nova.Double Tap: Two slows to chain a target down, lock your victim so the combo lands and they can't escape.
nova.Crippling Shot: Amps your whole combo by 20%, take it to guarantee the kill on a tankier target.
nova.Fast Reload: Chain-executes, land a kill and immediately snipe the next, can carry a won fight into a wipe.

orphea.Ancestral Strength: Rewards comboing off CC, hits harder on locked targets and your own slow enables the follow-up.
orphea.Allegrissimo: Near-spammable dash for poke and mobility, weave in damage and reposition constantly.
orphea.Mind Devourer: Your burst ramp, complete it and land free full-damage Dread eruptions for massive poke.
orphea.Crushing Jaws: Your wombo ult, pull their clump together for your team's follow-up or to peel a dive.
orphea.Invasive Miasma: Self-peel and sustain in one, punish melee that dive you and heal back while gaining Chaos.
orphea.Lurking Terror: A second Chomp for burst and slow, extends your combo range to catch fleeing targets.
orphea.Monster Within: Turns your zone ult into a rotation engine, spam abilities during Feast for relentless burst.
